title: Self-Distillation Enables Continual Learning [pdf]
summary: This research paper presents a self-distillation approach for continual learning, where a neural network preserves knowledge from previous tasks by using its own predictions as supervision signals, effectively preventing catastrophic forgetting without needing separate teacher models.
problem_solved: Addresses catastrophic forgetting in neural networks during continual learning, where learning new tasks degrades performance on previously learned tasks.
why_valuable: Provides a simple yet effective mechanism for lifelong learning in neural networks by leveraging self-distillation, eliminating the need for external teacher networks or complex memory replay systems.
